blindMapping: spec-based audit, no live blind comparison
fixes: src/server/domain/ledger/receipts.ts (cancel path near line 154) + purchase-orders repository: when a receipt is reversed, recompute PO status from the remaining active receipts. Started with 0 received goes back to Pending, and receivedAt is cleared when no active receipts remain. Write a change-log entry for each field reverted.

src/server/domain/ledger/receipts.ts line 68: stop stamping `receivedAt: po.receivedAt ?? nowIso()` on the first receipt. Stamp Actual Receiving Date (and CompletedDateTime) only when the transition goes to Completed, as the spec says.

src/components/receiving/receipt-drawer.tsx: after onCancel succeeds, invalidate or refetch the receipt-detail query (or close the drawer). This makes the drawer show the Cancelled callout and disables Cancel receipt, so the user cannot fire a second cancel that returns 409.

Change-log formatter (shared ChangeLogDrawer / PO audit writer): format date fields with fmt.dateTime instead of writing raw ISO strings. The current entry reads 'Actual Receiving Date is modified. --> 2026-11-09T22:20:39.489Z'. Also log line creation as '<SKU> -> Purchase order line is created.' instead of 'Ordered Qty is modified. --> 10'.

src/components/shared/address-card.tsx line 34: render the address whenever any of line1/city/state/postalCode/country is present. Do not require line1. A vendor with City=Mobile, State=AL currently shows 'No address on file' on the PO Confirm step while the Vendors grid shows 'Mobile, Alabama'.

src/components/receiving/wizard/step-products.tsx: the 17-column lines table makes the whole document 1846px wide at a 1440px viewport, so the app shell scrolls horizontally. Wrap the table in a container with `min-w-0 overflow-x-auto`, and add `min-w-0` to the wizard's flex/grid column parents so the overflow stays inside the card.

src/components/receiving/wizard/po-wizard.tsx (stepper): after jumping to step 1 on an existing PO and saving, the stepper still highlights Step 1 as current while the body shows Confirm. Derive the current-step highlight from the same state that drives the body. Also give visited-optional and just-completed steps one consistent treatment: no brown fill, no red-filled check.

src/components/receiving/wizard/po-wizard.tsx (PO Status ring): drive the % from completed steps (0/25/50/75/100) and disable Confirm purchase order until step 5, per spec. Today the ring shows 25% on an empty form and 100% 'Ready to save' at step 3. On an unchanged existing PO, show 'Saved' rather than 'Ready to save'.
src/components/receiving/wizard/step-products.tsx: disable Next (with a DisabledReason tooltip) while lines.length === 0, instead of allowing the click and then showing 'Add at least one product'.

src/components/receiving/wizard/po-product-search.tsx ResultRow: show a spinner on the + button and disable it while fetchProductInfo runs. The Edit Product drawer took 10+ s to open with no feedback. Also flip the button to the 'On this order' state for every added SKU (the second added SKU kept the red primary +).

src/components/receiving/receive-items-drawer.tsx: replace the raw putaway reason dump ('Check Damaged Locations · Suggest a location with the selected area type · Suggest an empty location (SAME_SKU_EMPTY_LOCATION_ALGORITHM · Empty storage location)') with one human sentence, e.g. 'Empty storage location in zone A'. Never render enum codes. Do not mention damaged-location rules on an undamaged receipt.

src/components/receiving/receive-items-drawer.tsx: validate every selected line and show all missing tracked attributes at once (lot and expiry together), not one error per Receive click. Give the quantity NumberInput an aria-label like 'Quantity to receive for <SKU>'; its accessible name is currently '0'.

src/components/receiving/receive-items-drawer.tsx: pin the '1 line · 6 units selected' summary into the sticky footer next to Cancel/Receive. It currently floats in the middle of the drawer body. Stop drawing a red border on selected line cards, because a red border reads as an error state; use the neutral selected border token.

src/components/receiving/po-columns.tsx: widen PO Number to fit 18–20 characters (≈170px) or let it auto-size. 'KS-TEST-E2E-4…', 'KS-TEST-DETAIL…' and 'KS-TEST-PO-M…' are truncated even though the grid has spare width. Apply the same change to PO Number in src/components/receiving/receipt-columns.tsx.

src/components/receiving/po-list-page.tsx: before opening the Receive PO confirm, check the selected POs for lot/expiry/serial-tracked open lines. Disable the action with a reason, or list the blocked POs inside the confirm. Today it confirms, then fails with '0 of 1 orders received · 1 failed'.
src/components/receiving/po-list-page.tsx: remove the permanently disabled 'Remove serial number' item (SERIAL_PREADVICE_REASON placeholder) or implement it. Dead menu items are not acceptable.

Use sentence case everywhere ('Purchase orders', 'New purchase order'). Fix the Title Case copy 'Custom Fields' and 'Create Custom Field' on step 4 (src/components/receiving/wizard/po-wizard.tsx / custom-field section).

src/components/receiving/po-create-page.tsx success state: hide the 'Cancel order' header button once the PO is created, and lay the 3 next-step cards out in one row of 3 (grid-cols-3) instead of 2+1.

Date formatting: use one formatter across the module. The list shows '11/06/2026 9:00 AM', the detail '11/9/2026', History expiry '5/8/2027' and the receipt drawer '11/9/2026 4:20:39 PM'. Pick the useFormat().date/dateTime pattern everywhere.
Warehouse label on Confirm/Order Details: show 'MLT1 - Main Fulfillment', not 'MLT1 · MLT1 - Main Fulfillment'. Drop the duplicated code prefix in step-confirm.tsx.

src/components/receiving/po-list-page.tsx header: render Import/Create purchase order placeholders (or reserve their space) while permissions load. They currently pop in after the grid loads and shift the toolbar.
Detail-page loading skeleton (shell-skeleton / po-detail-page.tsx): match the real layout's 24px page gutter and the stepper/rail geometry. The current skeleton is edge-to-edge and jumps on load.

Receiving history grid: hide the 'Selected: 0' footer counter on grids with no selection column (receiving-history-page.tsx / DataGrid footer prop). In the PO wizard vendor step, keep the footer 'Selected' in sync with the radio selection (it showed 0 while a vendor was selected).
functional_failures: Cancelling a receipt leaves the PO in a wrong state. Steps: 1) Create PO KS-TEST-PO-M05R1 (2 lines, 10 + 5). 2) On /receiving/<id> click Receive items and receive 6 of line 1 (lot L123, expiry 2027/05/08); the PO becomes Started. 3) Go to /receiving/history?q=KS-TEST-PO-M05R1, click Master Id 70125, click Cancel receipt, then Yes. 4) GET /api/purchase-orders?q=KS-TEST-PO-M05R1 returns status 'Started', receivedQuantity 0, activeReceipts 0, receivedAt '2026-11-09T22:20:39Z', and the list and detail still show Started. Expected: the PO reverts to Pending and Actual Receiving Date is cleared.

Actual Receiving Date is stamped on a partial receive. Steps: receive 6 of 15 units on a Pending PO through Receive items, then open Show change log. The log shows 'Actual Receiving Date is modified. --> 2026-11-09T22:20:39.489Z' while the PO is only Started. The spec says Completed stamps Actual Receiving. The value is also a raw ISO string.

The receipt drawer is stale after cancel and allows a duplicate cancel that gets a 409. Steps: on /receiving/history open the Master Id drawer for an active receipt, click Cancel receipt, then Yes (POST /api/receipts/<id>/cancel returns 200). The grid row now shows 'Cancelled', but the drawer still shows PO status Started and an enabled Cancel receipt button. Clicking it again and confirming sends POST /api/receipts/<id>/cancel, which returns 409 Conflict.

The vendor address is dropped on the PO Confirm step. Steps: in the /receiving/new step 3, click Add new vendor and enter Display name, Vendor name and City=Mobile (Country US, State Alabama defaults). Save and continue to step 5. The Vendor card shows 'No address on file' for Shipping and Billing, while /receiving/vendors shows Ships from 'Mobile, Alabama'.

Page-level horizontal scroll in the wizard. Steps: at a 1440x900 viewport on /receiving/new, complete step 1 and add 2 products on step 2. document.documentElement.scrollWidth becomes 1846 (window.scrollX reached 330), so the whole top nav and page scroll sideways. The lines table (width 1862px) is not contained.

The stepper is out of sync on the PO detail. Steps: open /receiving/<id>, click 'Step 1: PO details', edit Note, then click Save purchase order. The body returns to the Confirm view, but the stepper still highlights STEP 1 as current with the red box.

Next on wizard step 2 is not disabled when there are no lines. Steps: on /receiving/new complete step 1 and land on Products with zero lines. Next is enabled, and clicking it shows the 'Add at least one product' error. The spec says Next stays disabled.

The PO Status ring and Confirm do not follow the spec. Steps: open /receiving/new; the ring reads 25% before any input. After the vendor is selected on step 3 it reads 100% 'Ready to save', and Confirm purchase order is enabled at step 3. The spec says the ring goes %0→%100 by step and Confirm is enabled only at step 5.

Bulk Receive PO confirms and then fails on tracked products. Steps: on /receiving select a PO whose lines are lot/expiry tracked (KS-TEST-PO-M05R1), click Receive PO, then click Receive. The error toast reads '0 of 1 orders received · 1 failed. …CPL-BAG-DEC-12 is lot tracked…'. The action should be gated before the confirm.

A dead menu item. Steps: on /receiving select any row and open Delete ▾. 'Remove serial number' is permanently disabled with 'Serial number pre-advice isn't set up for purchase orders yet.', which is a placeholder.

The putaway suggestion leaks internal enum and rule text. Steps: open Receive items on a PO in MLT1. Under Receiving location the suggestion reads 'Suggested KST-A-01-1 — Check Damaged Locations · Suggest a location with the selected area type · Suggest an empty location (SAME_SKU_EMPTY_LOCATION_ALGORITHM · Empty storage location)'.

Add-product gives no feedback. Steps: on wizard step 2 search 'CPL' and click + on a result. Nothing visibly happens for about 10 seconds (no spinner, button not disabled) before the Add product drawer opens. A user can double-click and queue duplicate fetches.

The PO Number column truncates the primary identifier. Steps: on /receiving search 'KS-TEST'. The PO Number column shows 'KS-TEST-E2E-4…', 'KS-TEST-DETAIL…' and 'KS-TEST-LIST-1…' at 1440px with spare width. Receiving History also truncates 'KS-TEST-PO-M…'.

Tracked-attribute validation shows one error per attempt. Steps: in Receive items select a lot+expiry tracked line with both fields empty and click Receive. Only the 'lot tracked' error shows. After entering the lot, clicking Receive again only then reveals the 'expiry tracked' error.
logiwa_wins: Per spec, Logiwa's Cancel Order works on Started POs (Pending/Started). KitStaks disables Cancel order on a Started PO that has receipts ('Cancel its receipts first'), which forces a receipt-by-receipt reversal first.

Per spec, Logiwa's bulk Receive PO is a one-click full receive that works for every PO. KitStaks's bulk Receive PO fails for lot/expiry/serial-tracked POs and only reports the failure after the confirm.

Per spec, Logiwa's PO Status ring progresses step by step (%0→%25→%50→%75→%100), and Confirm is enabled only at step 5. KitStaks starts at 25% and reports 100% 'Ready to save' at step 3, so the progress signal is meaningless.

Per spec, Logiwa's Change Log shows human field names, formatted dates and an explicit 'Purchase Order Line is created' entry. KitStaks logs raw ISO timestamps and records line creation as 'Ordered Qty is modified. --> 10'.
Per spec, Logiwa's Step 2 Next is disabled until a line exists. KitStaks leaves Next enabled and errors after the click.

Per spec, Logiwa's right rail has Save Purchase Order at the top and repeated at the bottom. KitStaks shows it only at the bottom of an overloaded rail that repeats the same PO number, vendor and total in two cards.
Per spec, Logiwa's vendor drawer has an 'Address name' field. KitStaks has 'Contact name' instead, and its Confirm vendor card hides partial addresses that Logiwa's Shipping/Billing cards would show.
Per spec, Logiwa's Receiving History grid has no selection footer clutter. KitStaks shows a meaningless 'Selected: 0' on a grid with no row checkboxes.
